Description: An app-native reflective guide that turns seeker context into a consent-safe seeker map, token spend, and verified practitioner handoff.
Customer Benefit: Seekers feel reflected and understood before being sold to, helping them name their needs before choosing support.
Differentiator: Unique Mirror-guided flow starts with context rather than category, price, or time filters.

Description: A structured output of Mirror's reflection including resonance threads, modality weights, and suggested next actions.
Customer Benefit: Seekers gain a specific, actionable plan and a deeper understanding of their personal patterns.
Differentiator: Turns abstract spiritual reflection into a structured, visual map for guidance.

Description: Verified practitioner profiles with tiered session offers and consent-safe context handoff.
Customer Benefit: Provides access to quality, verified support with high-context relevance while maintaining privacy boundaries.
Differentiator: Context-aware handoff prevents practitioners from receiving cold, generic leads.

Description: New users receive 369 free tokens. An opening flow costs \sim108 tokens, with recharge anchors at 299, 599, 799, and 1099.
Customer Benefit: Allows users to test the utility of reflection before financial commitment; provides a concrete path to action.
Differentiator: A tokenized trust layer where recharge validates paid intent rather than simple lead generation.

Description: A technical boundary that ensures raw birth details or private reflections are not shared without explicit permission.
Customer Benefit: Provides relief and safety for seekers worried about sharing vulnerable context.
Differentiator: Consent-first data architecture as opposed to standard data-sharing practices in wellness apps.

Description: Profile-scoped product listings that are token-staked and manually reviewed by founders in beta.
Customer Benefit: Ensures that marketplace offerings are credible and contextual rather than generic shop listings.
Differentiator: Commerce is emerging from trust and manual review rather than open, unverified listings.

Description: Pricing starting at 299 in local denominations (THB for Thailand, INR for India).
Customer Benefit: Transparent, accessible entry points tailored to local market contexts.
Differentiator: Market-specific pricing anchors rather than global FX-equivalent packages.
